snippet.textDisplay:
While I agree with the many comments that first touch, vision, and passing are more important in real game situations,  in tough games when your team needs a goal sometimes a winger who can beat a defender 1v1 and get in behind is critical to unlock an otherwise tight team defensive structure.

The only one I think has chance is number 4 (first "hard" one). Plus if it goes wrong you are still goal side (relative to your goal) and can work to recover the ball.
